briefdescription.para: Constructs an AssetRegistry object.

detaileddescription.para: This constructor initializes the ShaderLibrary, Aseprite manager and sets the AudioManager pointer.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the AudioManager instance.

briefdescription.para: Deleted copy constructor for the AssetRegistry class to prevent copying.

parameterdescription.para: The instance of the AssetRegistry that is being copied.

briefdescription.para: AssetRegistry is a class that manages assets in the game engine. It's designed to be efficient and secure, but it doesn't allow copying or moving instances of this class for safety reasons.

simplesect.para: The function does not return any value.

detaileddescription.para: Loads a texture from the given file path and returns it as a reference. If the texture is already loaded, it will return that instance instead of loading again. The function checks if the texture is already loaded by its UUID. If so, it directly returns the existing texture. Otherwise, it creates a new Texture2D object based on the file type: .aseprite for AespriteManager, and regular image files otherwise. After creating the texture, it assigns an unique UUID to it and stores it in m_TextureAssets map with its UUID as key. Finally, it returns the loaded Texture2D object from m_TextureAssets using its UUID.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves a texture from the asset manager using its UUID.

detaileddescription.para:
This function searches for a Texture2D object in the m_TextureAssets map with the given ID. If it finds one, it returns a reference to that object. Otherwise, it logs an error and returns a nullptr.
ID
The UUID of the texture to retrieve.
A Reference (Ref) to the Texture2D object if found, otherwise nullptr.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves a reference to the Texture2D object associated with the given name.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all stored texture assets and checks if any of them have the same name as the input parameter 'Name'. If it finds one, it returns a reference to that Texture2D object. Otherwise, it logs an error message and returns a null reference.

parameterdescription.para: The name of the Texture2D asset to retrieve.

simplesect.para: A reference to the requested Texture2D object if found, otherwise nullptr.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a texture is loaded based on its file path.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over the map of textures (m_TextureAssets) and checks if any texture's GetTextureFilePath() matches the provided path. If it does, the function returns true indicating that the texture is loaded. Otherwise, it returns false.

parameterdescription.para: The file path to check for a loaded texture.

simplesect.para: True if the texture is loaded, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a texture with the given ID is loaded or not.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks if the texture associated with the provided UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is already loaded in memory. It does this by comparing the value of m_TextureAssets[ID] to nullptr. If it's equal, then the texture has not been loaded and the function returns false; otherwise, if it's not equal (i.e., the texture is loaded), the function returns true.

parameterdescription.para: The UUID of the texture to check for.

simplesect.para: True if the texture with the given ID is loaded, False otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a texture is loaded based on its file path.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over the map of textures (m_TextureAssets) and checks if any of them have the same file path as the one provided. If it finds a match, it sets the OutID parameter to the UUID associated with that texture and returns true. Otherwise, it returns false.

parameterdescription.para: The file path of the texture to check for.
A reference to an UUID variable which will be set if the texture is found.

simplesect.para: Returns true if a texture with the given file path exists in m_TextureAssets, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: This function loads a shader from the given file path.

parameterdescription.para: The path to the shader file.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: This function loads two shaders from the given file paths.

parameterdescription.para: The path to the first shader file.
The path to the second shader file.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: This function loads a shader into the Shader Library.

parameterdescription.para: The identifier for the shader to be loaded.
The source code of the shader.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: Gets a shader from the library by name.

detaileddescription.para: This function retrieves a shader object from the library using the provided name. If the shader does not exist, it will return an empty reference.

parameterdescription.para: The name of the shader to retrieve.

simplesect.para: A reference to the shader with the given name, or an empty reference if no such shader exists in the library.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a shader with the given name exists.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks whether a shader with the specified name exists in the shader library. It returns true if the shader exists and false otherwise.

parameterdescription.para: The name of the shader to check for.

simplesect.para: True if the shader exists, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Loads a scene from the specified file path and returns it as a reference.

detaileddescription.para: If the function is unable to load the scene due to an error, it will log an error message and return nullptr.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves a scene with the given UUID from the map of scenes.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes in an UUID and returns the corresponding Scene object from the map 'm_Scenes'. If no such scene exists, it will return an empty Ref<Scene>.

parameterdescription.para: The UUID of the scene to be retrieved.

simplesect.para: A reference to the requested Scene if found in the map; otherwise, an empty Ref<Scene>.

briefdescription.para: GetScene is a function that retrieves a scene from the map of scenes by its name.

parameterdescription.para: The name of the scene to be retrieved.

simplesect.para: A reference to the Scene object if it exists, otherwise nullptr. If no such scene exists, an error message will be logged and nullptr will be returned.

briefdescription.para: GetAllScenes returns a vector of all scenes in the system.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over the map m_Scenes and emplaces each scene into the returned vector. The scenes are stored as Ref<Scene> objects, which allows for polymorphic usage.

simplesect.para: std::vector<Ref<Scene>> A vector containing all scenes in the system.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a scene is loaded based on its path.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes in the file system path of a potential scene and checks if it exists within the list of currently loaded scenes. It does this by comparing the filename part of the path with the names of all currently loaded scenes.

parameterdescription.para: The file system path to check for a loaded scene.

simplesect.para: True if a scene is found at the given path, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Load a font from the specified filepath and return its reference.

detaileddescription.para:
This function creates a new instance of AGEFont with the provided filepath, generates a UUID for it, stores the font in the map m_Fonts using the generated UUID as key, then returns the newly created font's reference.
Filepath
The path to the font file.
Reference to the loaded font.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves a font with the given UUID from the map of fonts.

detaileddescription.para:
This function searches for a font in the map 'm_Fonts' using the provided UUID. If the font is found, it returns a reference to that font. Otherwise, it returns a null reference.
ID
The UUID of the font to be retrieved.
A reference to the font with the given UUID if it exists in 'm_Fonts'. Otherwise, a null reference.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves a font from the collection based on its name.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all fonts in the collection and checks if their atlas texture's name matches the provided one. If it does, that font is returned. Otherwise, nullptr is returned to indicate that no such font exists.

parameterdescription.para: The name of the font to retrieve.

simplesect.para: A reference to the requested font or a null reference if no matching font was found.

briefdescription.para: Get the names of all available fonts.

detaileddescription.para: This function retrieves a list of font names from the internal map of fonts. If the list is empty, it populates it by iterating over each font in the map and adding its name to the list. The resulting list is then returned.

simplesect.para: A const reference to a vector of strings representing the names of all available fonts.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a font is loaded.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks whether the given file path corresponds to any of the fonts in the system. It does this by iterating over all stored fonts and comparing their atlas texture paths with the provided one. If it finds a match, it returns true indicating that the font is loaded. Otherwise, it returns false.

parameterdescription.para: The path of the file to check for.

simplesect.para: True if the font is loaded, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Registers a new font with the system.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes in a reference to an AGEFont object and adds it to the map of registered fonts. The key for this entry is the AssetID of the font, which can be accessed using GetAssetID() method on the font object.

parameterdescription.para: - Reference to the font that needs to be registered.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: Loads a sound bank from the specified file path.

detaileddescription.para: This function loads a sound bank into the audio manager based on the type of audio engine currently in use. If the audio engine is WWise, it directly loads the bank into the audio engine using AudioEngine::LoadBank. For FModEngine, it creates a Sound Bank object and then loads that into the audio engine.

parameterdescription.para: The path to the sound bank file.

simplesect.para: True if the sound bank was successfully loaded, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a soundbank is loaded.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks whether a soundbank with the given filepath is loaded based on the audio engine type in use by the AudioManager. It supports two types of engines - Wwise and FMod. For each, it uses preprocessor directives to check if the corresponding SDKs are enabled during compilation.

parameterdescription.para: The path to the soundbank file.

simplesect.para: True if the soundbank is loaded, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Loads a sound file from the specified path and returns a reference to it.

detaileddescription.para: The function creates an AudioSource object with the given filepath, generates a UUID for the sound, stores the sound in the m_Sounds map under its ID, then retrieves and returns the sound using its ID.

parameterdescription.para: The path of the sound file to load.

simplesect.para: A reference to the loaded AudioSource object.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves an AudioSource with the given UUID from the map m_Sounds.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes a constant reference to a UUID (ID) and attempts to find it in the map m_Sounds. If the ID is found, the corresponding Ref<AudioSource> object is returned. Otherwise, a null pointer is returned.

parameterdescription.para: The UUID of the AudioSource to retrieve from the map.

simplesect.para: A Ref<AudioSource> object that corresponds to the given UUID in m_Sounds. If no such object exists, a null pointer is returned.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves an AudioSource with a specific name from the map of sounds.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all entries in the m_Sounds map and checks if the GetName() method of each entry returns the same string as the input parameter 'Name'. If it does, that entry is returned. If no such entry exists, a nullptr is returned.

parameterdescription.para: The name to search for in the AudioSource objects.

simplesect.para: A Ref<AudioSource> object representing the found sound or nullptr if not found.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a sound is loaded based on the file path.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all sounds stored in the m_Sounds map and checks if any of them have the same file path as provided. If it finds one, it returns true; otherwise, false.

parameterdescription.para: The file path to check for.

simplesect.para: True if a sound with the given file path is loaded, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Returns a reference to the unordered map containing all scenes.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a reference to an unordered map that contains all the scenes in the system. The key is of type UUID and the value is of type Ref<Scene>, which represents a scene reference.

simplesect.para: A reference to the unordered map containing all scenes.

briefdescription.para: Returns a reference to the unordered map containing all texture assets.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a reference to an unordered map that contains all Texture2D assets currently loaded in the game. The UUIDs of these textures are used as keys for this map.

simplesect.para: A reference to the unordered_map<UUID, Ref<Texture2D>> containing all texture assets.

briefdescription.para: Returns a reference to the unordered map containing all fonts.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a reference to an unordered map that contains all the fonts in the system. The UUID is used as the key and Ref<AGEFont> is the value.

simplesect.para: std::unordered_map<UUID, Ref<AGEFont>>& A reference to the m_Fonts member variable.

briefdescription.para: Returns a reference to the unordered map containing all audio sources.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a reference to an unordered map that contains all AudioSource objects in the system. The UUIDs of these objects are used as keys for this map.

simplesect.para: A reference to the unordered map m_Sounds.

briefdescription.para: Returns a reference to the unordered map containing all SoundBanks.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a reference to an unordered map that contains all SoundBanks in the system. The keys of this map are UUIDs and the values are references (Ref) to SoundBank objects.

simplesect.para: A reference to the unordered_map<UUID, Ref<SoundBank>> containing all SoundBanks.

briefdescription.para: Gets the shader library reference.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a reference to the shader library object, which can be used to access and manipulate the shaders in the library.

simplesect.para: A reference to the ShaderLibrary object.
